description: This file defines the class `KnapsackEvaluator` which evaluates checkpointing strategies by simulating peak memory usage, runtime, and distribution analyses in the context of activation recomputation in a neural network framework. It interacts with a graph info provider and implements algorithms for assessing memory and runtime trade-offs, especially for checkpointing and recomputation strategies.

classes.name: KnapsackEvaluator
classes.description: A class to evaluate checkpointing strategies by simulating memory and runtime trade-offs, especially in the context of neural network activation checkpointing.

methods.description: Simulates the backward pass to calculate peak memory usage during recomputation, given a graph, saved nodes, and node memories.

methods.name: None _validate_all_indexes_accounted_for_in_provided_output( self, saved_nodes_idxs: list[int], recomputable_node_idxs: list[int] )
methods.description: Validates that saved nodes and recomputable nodes cover all candidate nodes without overlap.

methods.name: dict[str,float] evaluate_knapsack_output( self, saved_nodes_idxs: list[int], recomputable_node_idxs: list[int], account_for_backward_pass: bool = False, )
methods.description: Evaluates the memory and runtime for a given checkpointing strategy based on selected saved and recomputed nodes.

methods.name: list[dict[str,float]] evaluate_distribution_of_results_for_knapsack_algo( self, knapsack_algo: Callable[ [list[float], list[float], float], tuple[float, list[int], list[int]] ], memory_budget_values: list[float], )
methods.description: Assess the distribution of memory and runtime results across different memory budgets using a specified knapsack algorithm.

methods.description: Finds the Pareto optimal knee point in the trade-off curve between runtime and memory consumption.
